_about: The kinds of idea Dreams may bring, in the order the page shows them. Code holds each idea to this and nothing else: a known kind, the fields a kind needs, a real web address where one is needed, and no repeat of an earlier idea. What each kind means is written in agents/dreams.md and agents/dreams/outward.md. needs: evidence (the days and what happened), sources (real http/https addresses), draft (the fields listed in draft). outward: only offered when looking outward (Settings, Dreams) is on. max: most ideas of this kind in one night.
